prompt:
Our biotech lab has been accumulating project decisions, team info, and protocol notes scattered across text files and people's heads. We now have a structured memory system set up (palace file is at /workspace/data/lab_palace.json), but it's been neglected and contains some very old, outdated entries from 200+ days ago that we no longer need.

Please do the following:
1. Add a new category called 'protocols' to the palace so we can store lab procedures.
2. Store at least 3 new relevant memories across different categories — covering things like a project status update, a team member detail, a protocol note, or a tool decision. Each memory should have at least one descriptive tag.
3. Create at least one connection between two related memories (so we can traverse related context together).
4. Clean up any outdated/decayed entries that have fallen below a weight of 0.3 — our old 2023-era notes should be removed.
5. Export a full snapshot of the palace in Markdown format to /workspace/output/palace_snapshot.md.
6. Save the current palace overview/status to /workspace/output/palace_status.txt.

The palace must remain at its current location (/workspace/data/lab_palace.json) throughout — do not move or recreate it at the default location.
